dslRule:
<!id: array-content-provider-get-instance>
<!description: Replace 'new ArrayContentProvider()' with 'ArrayContentProvider.getInstance()' for shared stateless instances.
This is a common optimization for stateless singleton providers, improving performance and reducing object creation.>
<!severity: INFO>

new org.eclipse.jface.viewers.ArrayContentProvider()
=>
org.eclipse.jface.viewers.ArrayContentProvider.getInstance()
;;
summary: Replaces 'new ArrayContentProvider()' with 'ArrayContentProvider.getInstance()' for an optimized singleton instance.
